CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2390 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (group R10-TICK-DRIVERS, branch fix/r10-tick-drivers), head 5f6d8fbd7141a01c9e30afae5b6d8a28f7368088. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain is on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor. Run tests/entities.py with `env -u BASH_ENV`.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from origin/main and follow them exactly. The newest `Fix review:` comment on the PR is blocked: `mutation: audit-find.js's cut-off arm is unpinned -- replyField reading unparseable text as an empty collection fails no check (197/0)`. Read it and its evidence in full. Fix it soundly: make the cut-off arm refuse or report rather than read as empty, and pin it with a test that kills that mutant; then re-execute steps 2-8 and re-take the body in full. The branch is behind main: merge origin/main (never rebase).
Return: push the code to `handoff/r10-tick-drivers` (fast-forward) and the body via tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh to `handoff-body/r10-tick-drivers`. Push nothing else; do not open, edit, comment on or merge any PR. A fixer writes no delivery row. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it. End with CODE=<sha> BODY=<sha>.
